title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.72
summary: Faster Fire TV Home and easier browsing across streaming services.

sections.heading: Home on Fire TV
bullets: Show the first Home rows from saved artwork and cards for the current account and layout.
Use normal Home loading when saved cards are unavailable and refresh the rows after startup.

sections.heading: Streaming services
bullets: Show Jump to row before browsing every shelf and load the selected shelf directly.
Reuse recently prepared shelves when the region and filters match.
